description.value: Taku Japanese Kitchen is a neighbourhood Japanese restaurant on Royal Oak Avenue in Burnaby, serving a sit-down menu in a no-smoking indoor dining room. With no outdoor seating, it offers a quieter indoor respite for cyclists passing through the Royal Oak corridor. It accepts Visa and Mastercard, making it a convenient cashless stop mid-ride.
